info.title: VidGrid API Reference
info.description:
Welcome to the VidGrid [REST](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Representational_state_transfer) API!

You can use this API to create and manage resources on your VidGrid account. The API is meant to be used server-side and all requests should be made over SSL.

Code examples can be viewed in the area to the right, and you can switch the language of the examples with the tabs in the top right.

get.description: This endpoint returns an array of Video Resources.

parameters.name: identifiers[]
parameters.description: The unique identifiers of the desired videos. When set, this takes priority over **identifier**.

parameters.name: include[]
parameters.description: An array of properties to be included with the returned Video Resources.

trash.description: If set to true, the video will be placed in the VidGrid trash for 30 days. If set to false, the trash will be skipped and the video will be deleted immediately.

patch.description: This endpoint updates a video and then returns it as a Video Resource.

view_permissions.description: Updates the video view permissions as visible to anyone (PUBLIC), requiring a login to view (TEAM) or private to the owner and admins (ONLY_ME).

get.description: This endpoint returns an array of Caption Resources.

parameters.name: identifiers[]
parameters.description: The unique identifiers of the desired captions. When set, this takes priority over **identifier**.

parameters.name: include[]
parameters.description: An array of properties to be included with the returned Video Resources.

get.description: This endpoint returns an array of Folder Resources.

parameters.name: identifiers[]
parameters.description: The unique identifiers of the desired folders. When set, this takes priority over **identifier**.

parameters.name: include[]
parameters.description: An array of properties to be included with the returned Folder Resources.

patch.description: This endpoint updates a folder and then returns it as a Folder Resource.

get.description: This endpoint returns an array of User Resources.

parameters.name: identifiers[]
parameters.description: The unique identifiers of the desired users. When set, this takes priority over **identifier**.

transfer_videos_to.description: Specifies whether to transfer this user's videos to another user, the organization's guest user, or to delete them permanently. Possible values: `{user_identifier}`, `ORGANIZATION`, `DELETE`

transfer_shared_folders_to.description: Specifies whether to transfer this user's shared folders to another user or to delete them permanently.Possible values: `{user_identifier}`, `DELETE`

get.description: This endpoint returns a list of videos by page.

post.description: This endpoint makes a caption request for a Video Resource. It returns a Caption Resource with a status but the caption will not be ready immediately.

video_identifier.description: The unique identifier of the video you are requesting a caption for.

type.description: The type of caption you would like to request. Possible values: `machine`, `professional`

post.description: This endpoint creates a folder and then returns it as a Folder Resource.

is_in_org_library.description: Whether or not to place this folder into the Organization Library.

post.description: This endpoint generates and returns a Token Resource that can be used for creating videos.

type.description: The type of token that will be used. See Token Types for more info. Possible values: `record`, `upload`, `direct_upload`.

video.description: Sets properties on videos created with this token.

title.description: Sets the title for the created video. If `recorder.hide_video_title` is set to `false` the end user will have the option to set their own title from within the recorder.

public.description: When set to `true`, an uploaded video will be viewable by anyone with a link. If set to `false`, a user must be logged in to your VidGrid account to view the video. If not set, your user or organization default settings will be used.

folder.description: Automatically add uploaded videos to a folder. This should be set to a folder **identifier**.

recorder.description: Configures recorder behavior when launched via a specific token.

auto_show_video_page.description: Whether or not to automatically open the video in the user's browser after recording.

auto_close_recorder.description: Whether or not to close the recorder when it is finished uploading the video. If set to `true`, the user will only be able to record one video with this token.

hide_video_title_input.description: Whether or not to allow the user to title the video after recording.

default_fullscreen.description: Whether or not the recorder should launch in fullscreen mode.

force_webcam_only.description: Whether or not the recorder should be restricted to webcam only mode.

auto_authenticate.description: Whether or not a user should be automatically authenticated the first time the recorder is launched after install. If set to `false`, the user will need to return to their browser and click record in order to be authenticated.

show_instructions_page.description: Whether or not to download the recorder without redirecting to the install recorder page. This happens the first time a use clicks record when using the iframe method.

webhook_extras.description: Any extra data that you would like to be sent along when Webhook events are fired.

post.description: This endpoint creates a webhook event.

video_identifier.description: The unique identifier of the video you are requesting a webhook event for.

payload.description: Extra data to be used by the event.

enabled.description: Whether or not this folder is in the Organization Library.

view_url.description: URL to view the playlist for this folder.

embed_url.description: URL to embed the playlist for this folder.

RecordTokenResource.title: Record Token Resource
RecordTokenResource.description: The Record Token Resource returned in a successful response.

token.description: One-time token that is used for authentication when recording and uploading a video.

token_key.description: Public identifier corresponding to the token.

expires.description: UNIX Timestamp (UTC) indicating when the temporary token will expire.

download_url.description: URL that can be used to download the recorder.

launch_uri.description: URI that can be used to launch the recorder.

iframe_button.description: Iframe containing a record button. It will handle downloading and launching the recorder.

UploadTokenResource.title: Upload Token Resource
UploadTokenResource.description: The Upload Token Resource returned in a successful response.

token.description: One-time token that is used for authentication when uploading a video.

token_key.description: Public identifier corresponding to the token.

expires.description: UNIX Timestamp (UTC) indicating when the temporary token will expire.

iframe.description: Iframe containing a simple upload dropzone.

iframe_basic.description: Iframe containing a simple upload button.

DirectUploadTokenResource.title: Direct Upload Token Resource
DirectUploadTokenResource.description: The Direct Upload Token Resource returned in a successful response.

token.description: One-time token that is used for authentication when uploading a video. It is then mainly used for informational purposes.

token_key.description: Public identifier corresponding to the token.

formAttributes.description: Form attributes necessary for the S3 upload.

formInputs.description: Key/value pairs necessary for the S3 upload. Important: **formInputs.key** contains a **${filename}** string that needs to be replaced with a unique file name for each file uploaded. This will also be used for the video title in VidGrid unless `video.title` is set in the Create Token request.

fileParamName.description: The required key name that should contain the file data for uploading. Important: Amazon requires this to be the last key/value pair included in the POST to S3.

cloudUploadCallbackUrl.description: URL to `POST` to once a video has finished uploading to S3 and is ready for processing. Returns a video identifier. Important: you need to include `cloudKey` with the request which is the value of `formInputs.key` after **${filename}** has been replaced.

VideoCaptions.description: Caption Resources attached to this video.

VideoJwts.description: A single-use access token that can be used to grant permissions for a video on VidGrid. On page load a new access token will be generated that allows the user to access the video for 6 hours, but the token in the URL will have expired. You can use the token with view or embed URLs as follows: `{embed_url}?auth={jwts.token_type}`

duration.description: Duration of the video in seconds.

filesize.description: Size of the video in bytes. Filesize may differ between videos uploaded and videos done processing.

filetype.description: File type of the video file.

height.description: Height of the video. Height may differ between videos uploaded and videos done  processing.

width.description: Width of the video. Width may differ between videos uploaded and videos done processing.

VideoSignedUrl.description: Signed URL that can be used to view the video file directly. Expires after 6 hours.

VideoThumbnails.description: Signed URLs that can be used to view video thumbnails.

signed_url.description: Signed URL for the video thumbnail.

signed_url_small.description: Signed URL for a smaller version of the video thumbnail.

VideoTokenKey.description: Public identifier corresponding to the Token Resource used when creating a video through the API.

VideoViewPermissions.description: View permissions for this video; public, team members (login required to view), group-restricted, or private (owner and admins can view).

CaptionResource.title: Caption Resource
CaptionResource.description: The Caption Resource(s) returned in a successful response.

identifier.description: The unique identifier for the caption on VidGrid.

language.description: The language of the caption file.

status.description: The current status of this caption resource. Possible values: `QUEUED`, `PENDING`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `CANCELED`, `FAILED`, `COMPLETED`

type.description: The type of caption resource. Possible values: `machine`, `professional`, `manual`, `machine_translation`

video_identifier.description: The unique identifier of the video this caption belongs to.

FolderResource.title: Folder Resource
FolderResource.description: The Folder Resource(s) returned in a successful response.

identifier.description: The unique identifier for the folder.

is_in_org_library.description: Whether or not this folder is in the Organization Library.

UserResource.title: User Resource
UserResource.description: The User Resource(s) returned in a successful response.

identifier.description: The unique identifier for the user.

UserPcty.description: Pcty reference data for a User

VideoEvent.description: A video event such as a play

payload.description: An array containing data for this event

user_id.description: The randtag identifier for the user that created this event

VideoResource.description: The Video Resource(s) returned in a successful response.

view_permissions.description: Video view permissions: visible to anyone with a link (PUBLIC), requires a login to view (TEAM), or private to the owner and admins (ONLY_ME).

pcty_video_references.description: Paylocity video references. To know if a video has been uploaded or inserted somewhere

VideoSummary.description: A summary of analytics on a video
